mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 1.0% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors seek yield in equities.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.0% (t-test p-value > 0.05 vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in federal funds rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals aggressive monetary tightening, reducing corporate profitability and investor risk appetite, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (t-test p-value > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate and increases in nonfarm payrolls indicate a robust labor market supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE decline and PAYEMS increase fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases (t-test p-value > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high consumer confidence (RSAFS growth > 0.5% monthly), strong housing market activity (HOUST growth > 0.5% monthly) amplifies positive equity returns through increased consumer spending and business investment.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth > 0.5% and HOUST growth > 0.5% in last month
failure_condition: The interaction between RSAFS and HOUST growth fails to yield positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of triggered periods (t-test p-value > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production above its 12-month moving average indicates robust manufacturing activity supporting corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average (t-test p-value > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In low inflation environments (CPIAUCSL < 2.0%), a federal funds rate above 0.5% signals preemptive tightening to prevent inflation acceleration, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In CPIAUCSL < 2.0% periods, the signal fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases (t-test p-value > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.0% for two consecutive months signals economic weakness reducing corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is above 5.0% (t-test p-value > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand and confidence, driving corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of RSAFS and HOUST growth fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases (t-test p-value > 0.05).
